verdict.rationale: Titan keys work with Google and Google Cloud services, with other sites supporting FIDO CTAP1, and across work and personal services. The probe notes that fleet management goes through the Google Workspace Admin console, a separate product. However, nothing documents Okta or Entra ID integration specifically, or an admin policy that enforces hardware-key-only authentication. Missing for 10: explicit Okta/Entra ID compatibility, documented admin enforcement policies requiring security keys, any independent hands-on corroboration of enterprise IdP rollout.
